text: Most important: the node and the critical-action line give the maintenance infusion rate as 10 mcg/min; the drug store 'Anaphylaxis — IV infusion' entry gives 5-15 mcg/min. The face figure and the Dosing text come from the drug store (a drug figure must come from the drug entry); the node's own 10 mcg/min is quoted under 'In this consult'. Not resolved.

Time-critical consult content NOT on the strip: push-dose epinephrine for peri-arrest and the position/leg elevation advice (in the consult's node flow it comes before the fluids tile); continuous albuterol for bronchospasm; the cardiac arrest dose and ECMO advice; the discharge criteria; antihistamines and steroids (not first-line); glucagon; refractory anaphylaxis options. The consult has 10 critical actions; the first 7 are kept.
The critical-action line's 'within 5 minutes of recognition' is in no node, so it is not on the tile.
The adult dose is flat; the weight box is the pediatric per-kg dose with its per-dose cap, and the pediatric line is quoted under 'In this consult'.
The drug store racemic epinephrine entry covers croup and post-extubation stridor only, with no anaphylaxis indication, so this is a steps tile built from the node.

The drug store has two weight calculators for this dose (low and high end), so the tile shows two weight boxes. Its repeat advice (once more after 30-60 minutes if partial response) is in the drug store text only. The drug store's own indication is refractory anaphylaxis (epinephrine infusion, volume and standard adjuncts have failed); the face shows the node's beta-blocked context.

Tile order follows the consult's node chain (IM epinephrine, repeat, infusion, fluids, airway, methylene blue); the gate's own traversal order puts the fluids node later, so the fluids tile carries an order flag.

The nebulized epinephrine tile names epinephrine with a dose, but the drug store has no entry for nebulized epinephrine in anaphylaxis (its racemic entry is for croup and post-extubation stridor), so it is a steps tile built from the node.

The IV fluid bolus is shown as a steps tile because the drug store has no crystalloid entry for anaphylaxis; the volume comes from the consult node only, with no weight calculator for the pediatric per-kg bolus.
